meaning: Source-derived valid Entity and Value Object witnesses for owned sum payload verification; validation is explicit, never inferred from nominal type or graph adjacency.
oracle: Evaluate checked base Rule expressions independently on structural facts derived from record recipes and authored field/path bindings. Preserve Entity identity equality, Value Object full-value equality, exact UInt64, ontology property projections, quantifiers, declared Rule references and nominal Enum/sum distinctions. Native output is never used to select a satisfying witness or compute expected results.
coverage: A sum is ready only when every named payload dependency has source-derived valid witnesses. Retain every variant and source node. Missing satisfying witnesses or bounded search exhaustion means not_evaluable, not an invalid domain or unsatisfiability proof. Entity, Value Object and Rule nodes themselves still require independent full lifecycle/control adapters; witness use is not their completion.
search: Use deterministic scalar boundary and declared Rule literal seeds, complete field vectors, one-field variations and bounded Cartesian search, preserving at most 16 accepted witnesses and one rejected probe per distinct base-validator failure prefix. Search at most 4096 attempts per record, including duplicate candidates. Rule evaluation is bounded at 65536 expression visits and depth 64; exhaustion remains not_evaluable. Existing sum expansion/case/project/payload limits remain intact; never return partial passing sum coverage on capacity overflow.
execution: Construct only checked record factories and their explicit pure Rule dependency closure inside the existing permission-restricted native observer. Use base create only; do not infer extensions, execute Operations/Workflows, query stores, publish events or write target output. References remain typed identity values or field projections, not database lookups.
observations: Verify source-predicted base validator order/pass/failure traces on selected accepted and rejected inputs, exact owned payload fields, identity/value keys, recursive freeze, component ownership, clone/foreign rejection, and descriptor-only input preservation including factory construction. Reject syntax-valid validator bypass, field/identity changes, payload dropping and input mutation. Structural facts are not factory-owned snapshots.
compatibility: Add one source pin without changing the 45 predecessor pins, source contracts, generators, default selections, relationship vocabulary, SFOL or AlchLang. Definition/scaffold are candidate navigation and finite verification evidence only.
